title: Enhancement of the electrochemical response of a V2O5 integrated biochar@poly(aniline–pyrrole) hybrid composite-coated graphite electrode
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19966-19981
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01022E, Paper

Md. Mahabur Rahman, Abdulla Al Mamun, Hideto Minami, Md. Kawsar Hossain, S. Manjura Hoque, Mostafa K. Sharafat, Hasan Ahmad
Calcined V2O5 is integrated into biochar@poly(aniline–pyrrole) composite by mechanical blending and the resultant BC@CCp@V2O5 hybrid composite-coated graphite electrode exhibited significant enhancement of capacitance value and retention stability.
